name: cctv
description: A surveillance camera with a separate lens face and a wall bracket.
useCase: Identify a surveillance camera or open its live view.
misuse: Use camera for taking a photograph.

16.reason: The rectangular camera housing, solid front glass and supporting bracket remain distinct. Their shared angle keeps the camera separate from a flared loudspeaker.
